newsitem.title: CANADA: Hashimoto lands in Toronto for Peru hostage talks.
newsitem.headline: Hashimoto lands in Toronto for Peru hostage talks.

text.p: Japanese Prime Minister Ryutoro Hashimoto arrived in Toronto on Friday for crisis talks with Peruvian President Alberto Fujimori on how to defuse the 45-day-old hostage standoff in Lima.

Hashimoto landed at Toronto's international airport amid signs of a widening rift between Lima and Tokyo on negotiations with Marxist rebels holding 72 hostages in the Japanese ambassador's residence in the Peruvian capital.

The two leaders, who have met twice in the past four months, arranged Saturday's summit by telephone two days ago after Hashimoto expressed concern about aggressive actions by Peruvian police ringing the Japanese envoy's home.
He has urged Fujimori, the son of Japanese immigrants, to exercise caution to prevent "accidents or incidents."
Before leaving Peru, Fujimori sought to defuse tension with Japan by acknowledging that stricter orders to police were needed.
But he added that he was prepared to allow the crisis to drag on for months.
